_comment: Aggregators-only variant: natural-language question sent to Exa with includeDomains restricted to the curated free legal aggregators (CourtListener, Justia, Google Scholar, OpenJurist, caselaw.findlaw.com). No per-row court-specific domain scoping — every row sends the identical aggregator list, so no court-url-map is required and the adapter is trivially portable to the public repo. Measures how Exa performs against public case law when the search is restricted to open aggregators.
